limitations.closure_criteria: A separately versioned cryptographic profile, key lifecycle, revocation model and interoperable vectors are frozen and externally audited.
limitations.description: Cryptographic proof mechanisms and federation-wide key lifecycle are implementation-profile concerns; the Seed canon defines their semantic binding points without selecting a provider.

limitations.closure_criteria: Each implementation profile publishes independent persistence, atomicity, recovery and fault-injection evidence.
limitations.description: The specification does not select or certify a storage backend. Persistence guarantees belong to separately identified implementations.

limitations.closure_criteria: Specify, implement and audit a separate coordination profile when consensus is required.
limitations.description: Distributed consensus is not part of the minimal Seed semantics.

limitations.closure_criteria: Complete unbounded formal refinement and breach-propagation proofs for a separately scoped assurance level.
limitations.description: Critical lifecycle properties are bounded-model checked, but universal breach propagation and unbounded implementation refinement proofs are not claimed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Publish an external audit report bound to exact release bytes, source commit and canonical-package digest.
limitations.description: Independent external third-party audit of exact rc12 specification release bytes has not been completed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Maintain complete migration coverage, canonical-package parity, generated-view parity, formal checks and black-box component audits.
limitations.description: The rc12 candidate retains rc11 compatibility evidence while moving implementation-specific guarantees outside the Seed canon.

limitations.closure_criteria: Each implementation and deployment publishes and retains its own operational acceptance evidence.
limitations.description: Host hardening, secret provisioning, backup retention, access control, monitoring and incident response depend on the implementation and deployment environment.
